## E-commerce Weekly Performance Snapshot

Use a **bar chart** for weekly revenue and a **line chart** for visitors, conversion rate, and average order value. This gives a clean view of scale, efficiency, and monetization together.

## Recommended Charts and Trend Readout

### Chart Recommendation
- **Bar chart:** Weekly revenue by week
- **Line chart:** Visitors, conversion rate, and average order value over time

### Weekly Metrics
| Week | Visitors | Conversion Rate | Avg Order Value | Approx. Weekly Revenue |
| W1 | 4,200 | 2.1% | 48 | 4,233.60 |
| W2 | 4,500 | 2.3% | 47 | 4,864.50 |
| W3 | 4,700 | 2.0% | 49 | 4,606.00 |
| W4 | 5,100 | 2.6% | 50 | 6,630.00 |
| W5 | 5,300 | 2.8% | 52 | 7,728.80 |
| W6 | 5,000 | 2.4% | 51 | 6,120.00 |
| W7 | 5,600 | 2.9% | 53 | 8,613.20 |
| W8 | 5,900 | 3.1% | 54 | 9,892.20 |

### Revenue Formula
Formula: **Weekly Revenue = Visitors × Conversion Rate × Avg Order Value**

### Trend Summary
- **Visitors** rise overall from 4,200 to 5,900, with a small dip in **W6**.
- **Conversion rate** improves across the period, ending at **3.1%**, the best week.
- **Average order value** increases steadily from **48** to **54**, supporting stronger revenue growth.
- **Revenue** grows from **4,233.60** in W1 to **9,892.20** in W8, more than doubling.

### Unusual Weeks
- **W3:** Revenue dips slightly despite higher visitors because conversion rate falls to **2.0%**.
- **W6:** A noticeable soft spot; visitors and conversion both drop versus W5, causing revenue to decline.
- **W8:** Strongest overall week, combining the highest visitors, conversion rate, and AOV.

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Build Bar Chart] https://www.google.com/search?q=bar+chart+weekly+revenue+ecommerce
- Action: [Button: Build Line Chart] https://www.google.com/search?q=line+chart+visitors+conversion+rate+average+order+value
- Action: [Button: Plot in Sheets] https://www.google.com/sheets/about/

## Sources
- Charting guidance: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/63824
- Revenue calculation basics: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revenue
- Visualization best practices: https://www.datawrapper.de/blog/chart-types/
